subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: throttle_deferred fires when the write guard decides to delay a write — emitted at the deferral decision, before the wait, and again at each re-evaluation
intent: ledger: enum(identity, host-umbrella) — which of the two windows blocked; queue_depth: int — writers concurrently inside the guard for that ledger in the emitting process, counted from guard entry to guard exit and sampled at the emission instant; deferred_ms: int — the *projected* wait, never elapsed; reset_at: timestamp — when the blocking window refills
